task.title: Assemble the full report pipeline and pass end-to-end parity
task.description:
**Conditional.** Only needed if the Pyodide spike decides to port the engine to TypeScript. Delete this story if the spike keeps Python.

## Why
The job runner needs a single function that turns fetched data into a finished report.

## Steps
1. Add `buildReport(inputs)` in `web/src/engine/` that runs the stages in the same order as `rebuild/cli.py` and returns the summary, board data and brief.
2. Define its inputs as plain data: league seasons, the trimmed player database, current values, value snapshots, the benchmark, the chosen roster and the run date.
3. Add an end-to-end parity test over every fixture.
4. Measure CPU time and peak memory for the largest fixture.

## Done when
- End-to-end parity passes for every fixture.
- Measured CPU time and memory are recorded as a comment here and are well inside 5 minutes and 128 MB.
